description: `list-topics` and `list-subscriptions` take `pageToken` and `pageSize` and answer `nextPageToken` beside the collection (spec `listTopicsResponse`, `listSubscriptionsResponse`), but the converter only recognizes page-number pagination, so neither got a paginated surface. Without it `.items` doesn't exist, and a caller reading one page would miss topics. Read from the spec 2026-11-01.
